default.alt: Recording of the one-line command in a terminal, on a demonstration card. The installer finds a dArkOS or ArkOS SD card with 6 games, plans 43 BIOS files (15.1 MB) for them, installs them and shows the summary.

handheld.alt: Recording of the full-screen installer on the 640 by 480 screen of a handheld, started from the Tools menu of dArkOS, on a demonstration card. It finds the 6 games on the card, plans 43 BIOS files (15.1 MB) for them, installs them and shows the summary. The A button chooses, and the bottom line names the buttons.
